title: The Nihilist Reading Of The War of Greedy Witches #Shorts
description:
The unconscious does not argue with The War of Greedy Witches; it simply acts first. The War of Greedy Witches (Japanese: 魔女大戦 32人の異才の魔女は殺し合う, Hepburn: Majo Taisen: 32-nin no Isai no Majo wa Koroshiau) is a Japanese manga series written by Homura Kawamoto and illustrated by Makoto Shiozuka. Agrat calls them Witches and explains that they can all manifest magical abilities by focusing on their greed, desires, and regrets.

Reproduction explains more of The War of Greedy Witches than any philosophy dares to admit. Before the thirteenth match, Agrat, who figured out that Agatha and Lakshmibai were still alive, ordered her to find and kill them, galvanizing her by calling her special, but she starts her match first. She is decapitated by Yang Guifei in the thirteenth match without revealing what her magic was, but she mysteriously reappears in Agatha, Lakshmibai, and Lilia's hiding place to attack them.
